### (a) Social posts

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will double the pace of scientific discovery. We should prepare now to put that extraordinary acceleration to work for everyone.

2. We believe the next 20 years could bring superintelligent AI—and with it, a doubling of the pace of scientific discovery. We must make sure science is ready to turn that acceleration into progress.

3. Superintelligent AI built within the next 20 years will double the pace of scientific discovery. We should meet that future with ambition, foresight, and a commitment to using new discoveries for the public good.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We are entering a period that will reshape how quickly humanity can answer its most important questions. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will double the pace of scientific discovery. That means breakthroughs in medicine, energy, materials, and beyond could arrive far faster than they do today. We should treat this prospect not as a distant abstraction, but as a reason to prepare with urgency and purpose. Our choices now can help ensure that faster discovery serves the public good, reaches people broadly, and strengthens our ability to tackle shared challenges. The opportunity is immense, and we are ready to meet it with clear-eyed ambition.
